name: cx-rules-only~p1
task: Never pick up the box in the other room. Try not to drop the key while the door is still closed, and whenever you hold the key, try to have the door open then or open it later.

value.feedback: CHANGES REQUIRED: Soft Response(has_door_key, door_open) is owed after every step the key is held, so the door must be open on the last step while the key is held. The task says to try to have the door open then or open it later, which permits opening it after the key is no longer held. Use soft RespondedExistence(has_door_key, door_open) to express that preference without requiring the door to open while the key is held.

NO CHANGES NEEDED: the hard Absence matches “Never pick up the box,” and both soft rules match the preferences. The precedence correctly puts door_open before key_lost; the responded-existence rule allows the door to open before or after the key is held.

texts: Never pick up the target box.
Prefer not to lose the matching key before the door opens.
If the matching key is ever held, prefer that the door opens at some point, then or later.
